entry.summary: A 30-day visitor visa on arrival with evidence of an outbound ticket.
entry.max_stay: 30 days, extendable for a fee at the Division of Immigration
entry.other: Work, study or stays over 30 days need an entry permit. Arriving without a return ticket can bring fines and deportation.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the US Dollar (USD). While many business in Majuro and Ebeye take credit cards, others do not. There are only a few ATMs in the Marshall Islands. Carry cash with you. The airport departure fee must be paid in USD cash.

laws.rule: You can drive for up to 30 days with either: an Australian driver's licence (digital driver’s licences may not be accepted), or an International Driving Permit (IDP) After 30 days, you must get a local licence. You must carry your licence when you drive. If you don't have a licence, your insurance may not cover you.
